mainTopic: Two sisters falling for יבום: איסור מצוה versus ערוה, רב's rule for all the עריות, and the new משנה of three brothers
overview: This amud deals with two sisters who fall together for יבום. First the גמרא explains why the משנה repeats the rule of איסור מצוה: when the forbidden woman's sister is also there, the רבנן do not drop their ban on אחות זקוקה, so she too does חליצה and not יבום. The גמרא then shows, with a צריכא, why the משנה needs both its one-brother and two-brother ערוה cases. It also shows that 'זו היא' leaves out the case of an איסור מצוה to each brother. Next comes רב's rule, backed by רבי חייא, that 'forbidden to this one, permitted to that one' works for the עריות of the first משנה. רב יהודה, אביי and רב ספרא disagree about which cases it covers, and רב ספרא builds a six-brother story according to רבי שמעון, with added צרות. A new משנה then teaches that two related widows falling to one brother do חליצה and not יבום, while רבי שמעון exempts them completely, based on 'ואשה אל אחותה'. The גמרא explains that the repeated ערוה line is needed for רבי שמעון, and then it begins discussing the איסור מצוה line, which continues on the next amud.

steps.title: This rule was already taught before
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא points out that the משנה's rule about איסור מצוה ואיסור קדושה was already stated in an earlier משנה.
steps.simpleTranslation: An earlier משנה already said: a woman forbidden by איסור מצוה or איסור קדושה does חליצה and not יבום. So why repeat it?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes its challenge by quoting the earlier משנה, which already gave this exact ruling. The point is that our משנה seems to be repeating itself.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The earlier משנה already taught that איסור מצוה (a rabbinic ban on certain relatives) and איסור קדושה (such as a widow to a כהן גדול) block יבום but still require חליצה. If our משנה says the same thing again, it seems to add nothing. The גמרא expects every line of a משנה to teach something new.

keyTerms.meaning: A prohibition based on the rabbinic 'מצוה' to obey the חכמים (the secondary forbidden relatives)
A prohibition based on the holiness of כהונה, such as a widow to a כהן גדול
She does חליצה (the release ceremony)
She marries the יבם through יבום

phrases.english: A prohibition of מצוה and a prohibition of sanctity:
she does חליצה and does not do יבום!

steps.triggerLanguage: איסור מצוה ואיסור קדושה חולצת ולא מתייבמת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the challenge on the משנה's phrase איסור מצוה ואיסור קדושה
steps.kashyaTarget: The משנה's repetition of the איסור מצוה / איסור קדושה rule
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Redundancy: the same ruling already appears in an earlier משנה, so repeating it seems unnecessary.

steps.title: Here the sister is also involved
steps.stepSummary: The earlier משנה spoke of an איסור מצוה alone. Our משנה adds a sister who also falls for יבום.
steps.simpleTranslation: There, it was only an איסור מצוה. Here, it is an איסור מצוה and her sister is also involved.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the two cases are not the same. Our משנה has an extra detail: the forbidden woman's sister is also waiting for יבום.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the earlier משנה only one woman was involved, and she was blocked by איסור מצוה. Here two sisters fall to the brothers together. So the real question now is about the second sister.

keyTerms.meaning: There (in the earlier source)
Here (in our משנה)
Alone, by itself
Her sister

phrases.english: There, it is a מצוה prohibition alone;
here, it is a מצוה prohibition, and her sister.
phrases.notes: The גמרא means her sister also fell to the same brothers for יבום.

steps.triggerLanguage: התם איסור מצוה לחודה הכא איסור מצוה ואחותה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the redundancy challenge by showing a difference between the cases
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Our משנה just repeats the earlier rule
steps.terutzMaskana: Our משנה adds the case where the forbidden woman's sister is also present

steps.title: What we might have wrongly thought
steps.stepSummary: Without our משנה, we might have treated the איסור מצוה like a full ערוה, which would free the sister for יבום.
steps.simpleTranslation: You might have thought: treat the איסור מצוה like an איסור ערוה, so the sister could do יבום. The משנה teaches that this is not so.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains what mistake our משנה prevents. We might have thought the sister is allowed to do יבום, and the משנה tells us she is not.
steps.deeperAnalysis: When one sister is a real ערוה to the יבם, she is treated as if she isn't there, so her sister may do יבום (as the משנה itself rules). We might have thought an איסור מצוה works the same way and frees the sister. The משנה's ruling of 'חליצה, not יבום' teaches that this is wrong.

keyTerms.meaning: It would enter your mind to say (the mistaken first thought)
A prohibition of forbidden relations (the most severe category)
It teaches us (that the first thought is wrong)

phrases.english: It would enter your mind to say:
let the מצוה prohibition stand
in place of a prohibition of ערוה,
phrases.notes: He means: treat it as being just as strong as a ערוה.

phrases.english: and she may do יבום. So it teaches us otherwise.
phrases.notes: 'She' here is the sister, not the woman who is forbidden.

steps.triggerLanguage: סלקא דעתך אמינא ליקום איסור מצוה במקום איסור ערוה ותתייבם קא משמע לן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Spells out the new teaching of the answer in step 2
steps.terutzResolutionType: Identifying a mistaken first thought (סלקא דעתך) that the משנה rules out
steps.terutzHavaAmina: An איסור מצוה works like an איסור ערוה, so the sister may do יבום
steps.terutzMaskana: The sister may not do יבום; she too does חליצה

steps.title: How could we think the sister may do יבום
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges the mistaken thought: by Torah law the forbidden woman is still bound to the יבם, so her sister is the sister of his זקוקה.
steps.simpleTranslation: Could the sister really do יבום? By Torah law the forbidden woman still stands before him, so he would be marrying the sister of a woman bound to him!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks how anyone could have thought the sister is allowed. The idea seems clearly wrong.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An איסור מצוה is only rabbinic, so by Torah law that woman is fully bound to the יבם for יבום. Her sister would then be 'the sister of his זקוקה', who is forbidden to him. So the mistaken thought seems too weak to need a משנה to reject it.

keyTerms.meaning: By Torah law
She lies before him (she is bound to him for יבום)
Encounters; here, has relations with
The sister of the woman bound to him by the יבום bond

steps.confusionAlert: The woman blocked by איסור מצוה is forbidden only by the רבנן. By Torah law she is still completely bound to the יבם. That is why her sister counts as the sister of his זקוקה.

phrases.english: And she should do יבום?
Since by Torah law she lies before him,
he would be encountering the sister of the woman bound to him!

steps.triggerLanguage: ותתייבם כיון דמדאורייתא רמיא קמיה קא פגע באחות זקוקתו
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the mistaken first thought proposed in step 3
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that we would have allowed the sister to do יבום
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: By Torah law the forbidden woman is still a זקוקה, so her sister is forbidden as אחות זקוקה. No one would think to permit her.

steps.title: The רבנן did not drop their rule for the sake of the מצוה
steps.stepSummary: We might have thought the רבנן would set aside their ban on אחות זקוקה here to allow the מצוה of יבום. The משנה teaches that they did not.
steps.simpleTranslation: You might have thought: because of the מצוה of יבום, the רבנן made an allowance here. The משנה teaches that they did not.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains why the mistaken thought made sense. We might have thought the רבנן would ease their rule so that יבום could happen, and the משנה tells us they did not.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Here both bans are rabbinic: the איסור מצוה on the first woman, and the ban on her sister as אחות זקוקה. We might have guessed the רבנן would set one aside so the מצוה of יבום could be done with the sister. The משנה shows their rule stays in place, so the sister does חליצה and not יבום.

keyTerms.meaning: Because of the מצוה (of יבום)
The רבנן acted (made an allowance)

steps.whatToRemember: Our משנה's ruling on איסור מצוה is not a repeat. It teaches that when the forbidden woman's sister is also present, the sister cannot do יבום either. The רבנן did not drop their ban on אחות זקוקה even for the מצוה of יבום.

phrases.english: It would enter your mind to say:
because of the mitzva, the רבנן made an allowance;
so it teaches us otherwise.

steps.triggerLanguage: סלקא דעתך אמינא משום מצוה עבוד רבנן קא משמע לן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 4 by giving a reasonable basis for the mistaken first thought
steps.terutzResolutionType: Explaining why the first thought was reasonable
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The רבנן would set aside their ban on אחות זקוקה for the sake of the מצוה of יבום
steps.terutzMaskana: The רבנן kept their ban; the sister does חליצה, not יבום

steps.title: Why teach the case of two brothers and two ערוה bans
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the משנה's case where each sister is a ערוה to a different brother. It asks why this is needed, since it seems to follow from the earlier case with one brother.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה says: 'If one of them was forbidden as a ערוה to this brother, and the other to that brother...' Why do I need this too? It is the same as the earlier case. What difference is there between one brother and two?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא moves to a new line of the משנה and asks why it is needed. The משנה already taught that a brother may marry the sister who is not a ערוה to him.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Earlier the משנה taught that if one sister is a ערוה to one brother, he may marry her sister. Now it teaches that if each sister is a ערוה to a different brother, each brother may marry the one permitted to him. The גמרא argues that this is the same rule applied twice, so the number of brothers should not matter.

keyTerms.meaning: Why do I need this as well?
This is the same as that

keyTerms.term: מָה לִי לְחַד מָה לִי לִתְרֵי
keyTerms.meaning: What difference is there between one and two?

phrases.english: 'If one of them was...' and so on.
phrases.notes: This quotes the משנה's case where each sister is a ערוה to a different brother.

phrases.english: Why do I need this as well?
It is the same as that!

phrases.aramaic: מָה לִי לְחַד מָה לִי לִתְרֵי?!
phrases.english: What difference is it to me whether it is one or two?!
phrases.notes: He means one brother with a ערוה or two brothers, each with his own ערוה.

steps.triggerLanguage: היתה אחת מהן כו' הא תו למה לי הַיינו הָך מה לי לחד מה לי לתרי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new topic on the next clause of the משנה
steps.kashyaTarget: The משנה's clause about each sister being a ערוה to a different brother
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Redundancy: the rule for one brother already shows the outcome, and adding a second brother should change nothing.

steps.title: Why the one-brother ערוה case alone would not be enough
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא begins its צריכא answer. From the earlier case alone, we might think the leniency works only because a second brother shows everyone the real rule.
steps.simpleTranslation: It is necessary. If the משנה had taught only the earlier case, we might say it works there because a second brother shows the rule. Here no second brother shows it, so we might have said no.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the question from Step 6 by showing that each case teaches something the other could not. This step gives the first half: why the earlier case alone is not enough.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the earlier case, one brother marries a sister, and a second brother keeps away from both sisters. People who see the second brother learn that a זקוקה's sister is normally forbidden. In our case both brothers do יבום, so nobody is there to show this. We might have feared people would learn the wrong lesson and forbidden it.

keyTerms.meaning: It is needed: each of two similar teachings is necessary
It taught us
A second brother who shows (the real rule)
I would say no (the law would not apply)

steps.confusionAlert: Here הָתָם (there) means the earlier case in the משנה, with one brother allowed and a second brother forbidden to both sisters. הָכָא (here) means our case, where each sister is a ערוה to a different brother.

phrases.english: It is necessary: for if it had taught us only there,
phrases.notes: "There" is the earlier case: one brother may marry, and the second brother is forbidden to both sisters.

phrases.english: that is because there is a second brother who shows the rule,
phrases.notes: By staying away from both sisters, the second brother shows that a זקוקה's sister is normally forbidden.

phrases.aramaic: אֲבָל הָכָא, דְּלֵיכָּא שֵׁנִי דְּקָא מוֹכַח,
phrases.english: but here, where there is no second brother who shows it,
I would say no.

steps.triggerLanguage: צְרִיכָא: דְּאִי אַשְׁמְועִינַן הָתָם
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts the answer to Step 6's question of why the second ערוה case is needed.
steps.terutzResolutionType: צריכא: shows each case is needed
steps.terutzHavaAmina: With only the earlier case, we would think the leniency depends on a second brother who shows the real rule. Without him, we would forbid יבום.
steps.terutzMaskana: Our case teaches that יבום is allowed even when no brother is there to show the rule.

steps.title: Why the two-brother ערוה case alone would not be enough
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא completes the צריכא. From our case alone, we might think it is easier because each brother's marriage shows the truth about the other, so the earlier case is still needed.
steps.simpleTranslation: And if it had taught us only here, we might say the opposite: here the two brothers show the truth about each other. In the other case they do not, so we might have said no. So both are necessary.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives the second half of its answer: why our case alone would not have been enough. It ends by saying both cases are needed.
steps.deeperAnalysis: When each brother marries the sister who is not forbidden to him, each marriage shows the other is a proper יבום. So our case is easier in its own way. In the earlier case only one brother marries, so we might have forbidden it. Each case could not be learned from the other.

keyTerms.meaning: On the contrary
Both of them
On each other
The other (case)

steps.whatToRemember: Both ערוה cases in the משנה are needed. With one brother, a second brother shows the real rule. With two brothers, each brother's marriage shows the truth about the other. Each case has its own reason to permit, so neither could be learned from the other.

phrases.english: And if it had taught us only here:
on the contrary, the two of them show the truth about each other,
phrases.notes: Each brother marries the sister who is not forbidden to him. That shows the other marriage is fine too.

phrases.english: but in the other case, no. So it is necessary.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאִי אַשְׁמְועִינַן הָכָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the two-sided צריכא begun in Step 7.
steps.terutzResolutionType: צריכא: shows each case is needed
steps.terutzHavaAmina: With only our case, we would think the leniency works only because the brothers show the truth about each other. We would forbid the one-brother case.
steps.terutzMaskana: Both cases are needed. Each has its own reason we might have ruled more strictly.

steps.title: What do the words "זו היא" come to exclude?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the משנה's line "זו היא שאמרו" and asks what the word "this" leaves out.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה said: "This is the case they spoke about." What does "this is" come to exclude?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא moves to a new line of the משנה and asks a clarifying question about its wording. This sets up the answer in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה says "this is" the case where a sister who is also a יבמה either does חליצה or יבום. Saying "this" suggests that only this case counts and some similar case does not. The גמרא wants to know which case is left out.

keyTerms.meaning: This is (the case) they spoke about
What does it come to exclude?

phrases.english: "This is the case they spoke about," etc.
phrases.notes: The משנה continues: her sister who is also her יבמה either does חליצה or does יבום.

phrases.english: "This is" comes to exclude what?

steps.triggerLanguage: ״זוֹ הִיא״ לְמַעוֹטֵי מַאי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves on from the צריכא to a new phrase in the משנה.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Which similar case the משנה's words "זו היא" leave out.

steps.title: It excludes an איסור מצוה to each brother
steps.stepSummary: "זו היא" leaves out the case where each sister is an איסור מצוה to a different brother. There the sisters cannot both have יבום.
steps.simpleTranslation: It comes to exclude the case of an איסור מצוה to this brother and an איסור מצוה to that brother.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the משנה's words leave out the case where each sister is only an איסור מצוה, a lighter ban, to a different brother.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The leniency of "this one marries, that one marries" works only when each sister is a true ערוה to one brother. An איסור מצוה is not a full ערוה, so the rabbinic ban on a זקוקה's sister still holds. In that case the sisters do not have יבום.

keyTerms.meaning: To exclude
To this one (brother)

phrases.english: To exclude an איסור מצוה to this brother
and an איסור מצוה to that brother.

steps.triggerLanguage: לְמַעוֹטֵי אִיסּוּר מִצְוָה לָזֶה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers Step 9's question.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: "זו היא" leaves out the case where each sister is an איסור מצוה to a different brother. There יבום is not allowed.

steps.title: Isn't this the same as the earlier איסור מצוה case?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges: we already know an איסור מצוה blocks יבום with the sisters. So why would two brothers be any different from one?
steps.simpleTranslation: Why do I need this too? It is the same as that. What difference is it to me if it is one brother or two?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא attacks the answer of Step 10, saying it teaches nothing new.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה already taught that when one sister is an איסור מצוה to the יבם, he cannot do יבום with either sister. The case with two brothers seems to follow from that. So why would the משנה need extra words to exclude it?

keyTerms.meaning: Why do I need this as well?
This is the same as that

keyTerms.term: מָה לִי לְחַד, מָה לִי לִתְרֵי
keyTerms.meaning: What difference is there between one and two?

phrases.english: Why do I need this too?
This is the same as that:
phrases.notes: "That" is the earlier case in the משנה, where one sister is an איסור מצוה to the one brother.

phrases.aramaic: מָה לִי לְחַד, מָה לִי לִתְרֵי?!
phrases.english: What difference is it to me whether one brother or two?!

steps.triggerLanguage: הָא תּוּ לְמָה לִי, הַיְינוּ הָךְ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the answer given in Step 10.
steps.kashyaTarget: The answer that "זו היא" excludes the case of an איסור מצוה to each brother.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The earlier איסור מצוה case with one brother already teaches this rule. The number of brothers should make no difference, so excluding the two-brother case teaches nothing new.

steps.title: Even with no second brother to worry about, an איסור מצוה is not treated like an ערוה
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers the question from step 11. Without this teaching, we might have thought that when each sister is forbidden to a different brother, there is nothing to worry about, so each brother could do יבום. The משנה teaches that this is not so.
steps.simpleTranslation: You might have said: we refuse to treat an איסור מצוה like an איסור ערוה only when there is reason to make a decree because of the second brother. But where there is no such reason, you might say: for this brother let us treat the איסור מצוה like an ערוה, and for that brother too, and then both may do יבום. So the משנה teaches us that this is not so.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains why the משנה needed to teach the two-brother case. Without it, we might have wrongly allowed both brothers to do יבום.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the one-brother case, we do not treat an איסור מצוה like an ערוה because there is reason to make a decree on account of the second brother. When each sister is forbidden to a different brother, that worry seems to be gone. So we might have treated each איסור מצוה like an ערוה and let each brother marry the other sister. 'זו היא' teaches that the rule stays the same even here.

keyTerms.meaning: 'You might have said': introduces a mistaken idea that the teaching comes to rule out
A prohibition based on a מצוה (a lighter level of prohibition)
A prohibition of a forbidden relative (the most severe kind)
To make a rabbinic decree (גזירה)
'It teaches us': the teaching rules out the mistaken idea

steps.whatToRemember: An איסור מצוה is never treated like an איסור ערוה here. This holds whether one brother is involved or two.

phrases.english: You might have said:
The time we do not say
'Let a prohibition of a מצוה stand'
'in the place of a prohibition of a forbidden relative'
phrases.notes: He means: treat the lighter איסור מצוה as if it were as strong as an ערוה.

phrases.english: is where there is reason to decree because of the second brother,
but where there is no reason
to decree because of the second brother,
I might say: for this brother let us stand
the prohibition of a מצוה in the place of a prohibition of a forbidden relative,
and for that brother let us stand
phrases.notes: The word in square brackets is part of the corrected wording. It repeats 'let us stand' for the second brother.

phrases.english: the prohibition of a מצוה in the place of a prohibition of a forbidden relative,
and let them both do יבום,
so it teaches us that this is not so.

steps.triggerLanguage: מַהוּ דְּתֵימָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the קשיא of step 11 by showing a real mistaken idea that the משנה needed to rule out.
steps.terutzResolutionType: מהו דתימא: shows a reasonable mistaken idea that the teaching needed to block
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Since there is no second brother to worry about, each איסור מצוה could be treated like an ערוה, so both brothers could do יבום.
steps.terutzMaskana: Even in the two-brother case, an איסור מצוה is not treated like an ערוה, so the sisters cannot both have יבום.

steps.title: רב's rule for all the עריות: forbidden to one brother, permitted to the other
steps.stepSummary: רב יהודה in the name of רב, supported by a ברייתא of רבי חייא, teaches a rule for every ערוה case in the first משנה. If two sisters come for יבום and each is an ערוה to one brother, each is permitted to the other brother. She may do either חליצה or יבום.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב יהודה said in the name of רב, and רבי חייא also taught this: For all of them, I can apply the rule 'the one forbidden to this brother is permitted to that brother.' Also, when her sister is her co-יבמה, she may either do חליצה or do יבום.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a new statement connected to our topic. It applies the 'forbidden to one, permitted to the other' rule to all the עריות listed at the start of the מסכת.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Unlike an איסור מצוה, a real ערוה completely removes that sister from the brother she is forbidden to. So her sister is not blocked for that brother, and each sister can go to the brother she is permitted to. רב says this works for every ערוה on the list.

keyTerms.meaning: 'In all of them': all the עריות listed in the first משנה of the מסכת
Her co-יבמה: another woman waiting for יבום from the same family
She does חליצה (the release ceremony)
She does יבום (marries the brother-in-law)

phrases.english: Rav Yehuda said that Rav said,
and so too Rabbi Ḥiyya taught:
Regarding all of them, I can apply to them,
phrases.notes: 'All of them' are the fifteen women listed in the very first משנה of the מסכת.

phrases.english: 'the one forbidden to this brother is permitted to that brother,'
and 'when her sister is her co-yevama'
she either does חליצה or does יבום.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה אָמַר רַב, וְכֵן תָּנֵי רַבִּי חִיָּיא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: After finishing the איסור מצוה discussion, the גמרא moves to a related teaching about real עריות.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: In all the ערוה cases of the first משנה, if each sister is forbidden to a different brother, each is permitted to the other brother. She may do חליצה or יבום.

steps.title: רב יהודה limits the rule: from 'his mother-in-law' onward, not the first six
steps.stepSummary: רב יהודה explains that רב's rule only covers the list starting from 'his mother-in-law.' It does not cover the first six cases of the משנה.
steps.simpleTranslation: And רב יהודה explains the rule as applying from 'his mother-in-law' and onward. But the first six cases are not included.
steps.whatsHappening: רב יהודה narrows the rule he just taught. He cuts off the first six cases in the list.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The first six cases in the משנה are a man's daughter and wife's daughter and their descendants. רב יהודה says the 'forbidden to one, permitted to the other' rule starts only from the mother-in-law. The next steps explain why.

keyTerms.meaning: Explains / interprets
His mother-in-law
The first six cases at the start of the list

phrases.english: And Rav Yehuda explains it as applying
from his mother-in-law and onward,
but the six cases at the beginning, no.
phrases.notes: These six are his daughter, his daughter's daughter, his son's daughter, his wife's daughter, and her son's and daughter's daughters.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְרַב יְהוּדָה מְתַרְגֵּם מֵחֲמוֹתוֹ וְאֵילָךְ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Limits the broad rule of step 13 to part of the list.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The rule of step 13 applies from 'his mother-in-law' onward, not to the first six cases.

steps.title: Why leave out the first six?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks for the reason behind רב יהודה's limit.
steps.simpleTranslation: What is the reason?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks why רב יהודה leaves out the first six cases. This sets up the answer in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: At first glance, a daughter is a full ערוה just like a mother-in-law. So we need to know what makes the first six cases different.

keyTerms.meaning: What is the reason?

phrases.english: What is the reason?

steps.triggerLanguage: מַאי טַעְמָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks for the reason behind the limit in step 14.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why רב יהודה's rule does not cover the first six cases of the list.

steps.title: The daughter case only happens through אונס, never through marriage
steps.stepSummary: Two sisters who are each the daughter of a different brother can only exist if the brothers had them through אונס. Through נישואין this cannot happen.
steps.simpleTranslation: Because his daughter in this case can only be found through אונס. Through marriage you cannot find it.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the first six cases cannot happen through normal marriage. That is why רב יהודה leaves them out.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For two sisters to each be a daughter of a different brother, both brothers must have had children with the same woman. If one brother had married her, she would be his brother's wife and forbidden to the other brothers, so this could not happen. It is only possible when the first brother had a daughter with her through אונס, so she never became his wife.

keyTerms.meaning: His daughter
Forced relations (not a marriage)
Marriage

steps.whatToRemember: רב's rule covers the עריות from 'his mother-in-law' onward. The first six are left out because the case could only arise through אונס, never through נישואין.
steps.confusionAlert: רב יהודה does not say the daughter is less of an ערוה. He means the two-sisters setup cannot happen with daughters through normal marriage.

phrases.english: Since his daughter
can be found only through rape,
phrases.notes: Both brothers would need daughters from the same woman. That only works if she was never married to the first brother.

phrases.english: but through marriage you cannot find it.

steps.triggerLanguage: כֵּיוָן דְּבִתּוֹ בְּאוּנְסִין הוּא דְּמַשְׁכַּחַתְּ לַהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 15.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The first six cases (daughters) can only be two sisters before two brothers through אונס, not through marriage. So רב יהודה does not include them.

steps.title: The rule only speaks about marriage, not rape
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא finishes רב יהודה's reason: רב's rule deals with cases that come through נישואין, not cases that come through אונס.
steps.simpleTranslation: The rule is talking about marriages. It is not talking about rapes.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא completes the answer from step 16. Since the 'two daughters' cases only happen through אונס, and the rule only speaks about נישואין, those first cases are left out.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Step 16 showed that two sisters who are each the daughter of a different brother can only happen through אונס. This line adds the missing point: רב's rule (and רבי חייא's ברייתא) only discusses normal married situations. So the first six cases of the משנה, which would need אונס, are not included.

keyTerms.meaning: Marriage; a proper, permitted marriage
Cases of rape, where a child is born outside of marriage
It is talking about; it deals with

steps.whatToRemember: According to רב יהודה, רב's rule only covers situations that come about through marriage. That is why the first six cases of the משנה are left out.

phrases.english: It is dealing with marriages,
phrases.notes: 'It' means רב's rule and רבי חייא's ברייתא from step 13.

phrases.english: it is not dealing with rapes.

steps.triggerLanguage: בְּנִשּׂוּאִין קָמַיְירֵי, בְּאוּנְסִין לָא קָא מַיְירֵי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the answer given in step 16 by stating the principle behind it.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why רב יהודה limits רב's rule to the cases starting from 'his mother-in-law'.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The rule only deals with cases that come through marriage. The daughter cases can only come through rape, so they are not included.

steps.title: אביי includes even a daughter from rape
steps.stepSummary: אביי says the rule applies even to a man's daughter from a woman he raped. Since such a case can be found, the rule covers it whether it comes through אונס or through נישואין.
steps.simpleTranslation: אביי explains the rule as including even his daughter from a woman he raped. Since the case can be found, it does not matter. If it comes through rape, fine; if it comes through marriage, fine.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי disagrees with רב יהודה and says the rule does include the daughter cases. All that matters is that such a case can really happen.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For רב יהודה, the rule only speaks about marriage. For אביי, the only question is whether the case can exist at all. Since two sisters who are each a different brother's daughter can exist through אונס, the case is included, even though it does not come through marriage.

keyTerms.meaning: Explains; interprets (the rule)
The woman he raped
You can find it; the case can really happen
If it wants; whichever way

steps.confusionAlert: אביי is not saying the rule speaks about rape instead of marriage. He is saying that it makes no difference how the case comes about, as long as it can happen.

phrases.english: And אביי explains
even his daughter from a woman he raped,
phrases.notes: Some versions leave out the word in round brackets. It does not change the meaning.

phrases.english: since you can find it,
if it wants, let it be through rapes,
if it wants, let it be through marriages.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאַבָּיֵי מְתַרְגֵּם אַף בִּתּוֹ (בָּאָה) מֵאֲנוּסָתוֹ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Offers a different reading of רב's rule from רב יהודה's limit in steps 14-17.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: רב's rule includes even a daughter from rape, because any case that can really happen is included.

steps.title: אביי still excludes the wife of a brother who never lived alongside him
steps.stepSummary: אביי says the rule does not include אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו. That case can only happen according to רבי שמעון, not according to the רבנן, and the ברייתא does not deal with disputed cases.
steps.simpleTranslation: But the wife of his brother who was not alive in his lifetime is not included. Since you can only find that case according to רבי שמעון, and you cannot find it according to the רבנן, it is not included, because the rule does not deal with a disputed case.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי sets a limit on his own approach. One case from the משנה is still left out.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For two sisters to each be אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו to a different brother, you need a situation that only works according to רבי שמעון's opinion. According to the רבנן, such a pair cannot be found. אביי holds that רבי חייא's ברייתא only speaks about cases that everyone agrees can happen, not cases that depend on a מחלוקת.

keyTerms.meaning: The wife of a brother who died before this brother was born; she is forbidden to him
According to the opinion of
A dispute between תנאים

phrases.aramaic: אֲבָל אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה בְּעוֹלָמוֹ — לָא.
phrases.english: But the wife of his brother who was not in his world is not included.

phrases.aramaic: כֵּיוָן דְּאַלִּיבָּא דְּרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן הוּא דְּמַשְׁכַּחַתְּ לַהּ,
phrases.english: Since it is only according to רבי שמעון that you can find it,
and according to the רבנן you cannot find it,
it does not deal with a disputed case.
phrases.notes: 'It' means רבי חייא's ברייתא. It only gives cases that work according to everyone.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֲבָל אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה בְּעוֹלָמוֹ לָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Sets a limit on אביי's wider approach from step 18.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Even according to אביי, the rule does not include אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו, because that case only works according to רבי שמעון.

steps.title: רב ספרא includes even the wife of a brother who never lived alongside him
steps.stepSummary: רב ספרא says the rule includes even אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו. It can be found with six brothers according to רבי שמעון, and he gives a memory sign: 'died, born, did יבום; died, born, did יבום.'
steps.simpleTranslation: רב ספרא explains the rule as including even the wife of his brother who was not alive in his lifetime. You can find it with six brothers, according to רבי שמעון. Your memory sign is: died, born, did יבום; died, born, did יבום.
steps.whatsHappening: רב ספרא goes further than אביי and includes even this last case. He gives a short memory sign and prepares to lay out the full story in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: אביי left the case out because it only works according to רבי שמעון. רב ספרא does not mind that, and holds that the rule can include it according to רבי שמעון's view. The memory sign lists the order of events that happens twice: a brother dies, a new brother is born, and another brother does יבום.

keyTerms.meaning: Six brothers
Your memory sign
He did יבום (married his brother's widow)

phrases.english: And רב ספרא explains

phrases.aramaic: אַף אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה בְּעוֹלָמוֹ,
phrases.english: even the wife of his brother who was not in his world,
and you can find it with six brothers
and according to רבי שמעון.
And your memory sign is:
died, born, and did יבום;
phrases.notes: This is the order of events in the story that comes right next. It happens twice.

phrases.english: died, born, and did יבום.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְרַב סָפְרָא מְתַרְגֵּם אַף אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה בְּעוֹלָמוֹ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Disagrees with אביי's limit in step 19 and includes the case he left out.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: רב's rule includes even אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו, as found with six brothers according to רבי שמעון.

steps.title: The six-brothers story that makes רב ספרא's case work
steps.stepSummary: רב ספרא's case is laid out: two brothers marry two sisters, two other brothers marry unrelated women. Then twice a brother dies, a new brother is born, and another brother does יבום. When the two brothers who did יבום die childless, the two sisters fall before the two newborn brothers.
steps.simpleTranslation: ראובן and שמעון were married to two sisters. לוי and יהודה were married to two unrelated women. ראובן died, יששכר was born, and לוי did יבום. שמעון died, זבולון was born, and יהודה did יבום. Then לוי and יהודה died without children, and the two sisters fell before יששכר and זבולון.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא spells out the exact story behind רב ספרא's memory sign. It shows how each sister is forbidden to one newborn brother but not to the other.
steps.deeperAnalysis: ראובן died before יששכר was born, so his widow is אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו to יששכר. זבולון was born only after לוי had already done יבום with her, so רבי שמעון would allow her to זבולון. In the same way, שמעון's widow is forbidden to זבולון but allowed to יששכר, who was alive together with שמעון. So each sister is an ערוה to a different brother, which is exactly the setup רב's rule needs.

keyTerms.meaning: Unrelated women (not related to each other or to the sisters)
Without children
Fell before; came to them for יבום

steps.whatToRemember: There are three views on רב's rule: רב יהודה leaves out the first six cases, אביי includes the daughter cases but not אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו, and רב ספרא includes even that case, according to רבי שמעון.
steps.whyThisMatters: The story shows why this case only works according to רבי שמעון. According to the רבנן, ראובן's widow would stay forbidden to זבולון too, so the sisters would not be split between the two brothers.

phrases.english: ראובן and שמעון were married to two sisters,
phrases.notes: All six people in this story are brothers to each other.

phrases.english: לוי and יהודה were married to two unrelated women.
phrases.notes: Here נכריות does not mean non-Jews. It just means women who are not related to the sisters.

phrases.aramaic: מֵת רְאוּבֵן, נוֹלַד יִשָּׂשכָר, וְיִיבֵּם לֵוִי.
phrases.english: ראובן died, יששכר was born, and לוי did יבום.

phrases.aramaic: מֵת שִׁמְעוֹן, נוֹלַד זְבוּלֻן, וְיִיבֵּם יְהוּדָה.
phrases.english: שמעון died, זבולון was born, and יהודה did יבום.
לוי and יהודה died without children,
and they fell before יששכר and זבולון.

steps.triggerLanguage: רְאוּבֵן וְשִׁמְעוֹן נְשׂוּאִין שְׁתֵּי אֲחָיוֹת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Spells out the six-brothers case that רב ספרא and his memory sign pointed to.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: With six brothers, according to רבי שמעון, two sisters can each be אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו to a different brother, so רב's rule applies to them.

steps.title: Each sister is forbidden to one brother and permitted to the other
steps.stepSummary: רב ספרא's case ends this way: each sister is forbidden to one newborn brother and permitted to the other. So the case fits 'her sister who is her יבמה.'
steps.simpleTranslation: The one forbidden to this brother is permitted to that brother. And the one forbidden to this brother is permitted to that brother. And so we have her sister who is her יבמה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes רב ספרא's six-brothers case. It shows how it ends: each sister is blocked from one newborn brother but allowed to the other.
steps.deeperAnalysis: ראובן's wife is forbidden to יששכר, since he was born after ראובן died. According to רבי שמעון she is allowed to זבולון, because when he was born she was already לוי's wife. שמעון's wife is the mirror image. So both sisters fall to יבום together and still each can marry a different brother, which is the case of 'her sister who is her יבמה.'

keyTerms.meaning: Forbidden to this one (one of the newborn brothers)
Permitted to that one (the other newborn brother)
Her sister who is also her יבמה: two sisters who fall to יבום together

steps.confusionAlert: Don't mix up the two newborns. Each sister is forbidden to the brother born after her first husband died, and permitted to the other one.

phrases.english: The one forbidden to this one is permitted to that one.
phrases.notes: This is ראובן's wife: forbidden to יששכר, permitted to זבולון.

phrases.english: And the one forbidden to this one is permitted to that one.
phrases.notes: This is שמעון's wife: forbidden to זבולון, permitted to יששכר.

phrases.english: And so we have her sister who is her יבמה.

steps.triggerLanguage: הָאֲסוּרָה לָזֶה מוּתֶּרֶת לָזֶה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes the case that רב ספרא set up in Step 20 and laid out in Step 21.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: In רב ספרא's case, each sister is forbidden to one newborn brother and permitted to the other, so the case of 'her sister who is her יבמה' really can happen.

steps.title: Why does the case need יהודה to do יבום?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why the case needs יהודה to do יבום, since the same result can happen without him.
steps.simpleTranslation: Why do I need the detail that יהודה did יבום? Even without יהודה doing יבום, you can find this case!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges one detail of רב ספרא's case. It says the detail looks unnecessary.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The point of the case was only to show that each sister can be forbidden to one brother and permitted to the other. That result can be reached with fewer brothers, without יהודה doing יבום. So why build the longer case?

keyTerms.meaning: Why do I need this?
He did יבום (married his dead brother's widow)
You can find it (the case can happen)

phrases.english: Why do I need 'יהודה did יבום'?
Even without יהודה doing יבום
you can find this case!

steps.triggerLanguage: לְמָה לִי יִיבֵּם יְהוּדָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Questions a detail in the case that was just finished.
steps.kashyaTarget: The detail in רב ספרא's case that יהודה did יבום
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The case seems to include an extra step that isn't needed to get the result.

steps.title: The extra detail is there to create a צרה
steps.stepSummary: Answer: the detail is needed so the case also covers a צרה.
steps.simpleTranslation: It is because of the צרה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that יהודה's יבום is needed so the case also works for a צרה, a co-wife.
steps.deeperAnalysis: לוי and יהודה each already had his own wife. When each did יבום, his own wife became a צרה of the sister he married. So the longer case makes the rule work for the צרות too, not only for the sisters.

keyTerms.meaning: Co-wife: another wife of the same husband
Because of

phrases.english: Because of the צרה.
phrases.notes: לוי and יהודה already had wives, so those wives become co-wives of the sisters.

steps.triggerLanguage: מִשּׁוּם צָרָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge in Step 23.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Explains the purpose of the extra detail
steps.terutzHavaAmina: יהודה's יבום is extra and not needed.
steps.terutzMaskana: It is needed so that the case also covers a צרה.

steps.title: What about a צרה of a צרה?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks: this covers a צרה, but how does the case cover a צרה דצרה?
steps.simpleTranslation: This works for a צרה. But what can be said about a צרה of a צרה?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא accepts the answer for a צרה, but challenges it again. The rule also needs to cover a צרה דצרה, a co-wife of the co-wife.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The case now has a צרה. But the list being explained also includes a צרה דצרה, and the case as built has no one in that role. So the case still seems incomplete.

keyTerms.meaning: This works out well for...
The co-wife of a co-wife
What can be said? (how do we explain it?)

phrases.english: This works well for a צרה,
but what can be said about a צרה of a צרה?

steps.triggerLanguage: הָא תִּינַח צָרָה, צָרָה דְצָרָה מַאי אִיכָּא לְמֵימַר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Builds on the answer in Step 24 and asks for one more level.
steps.kashyaTarget: The answer that the case is built for a צרה
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Explaining the צרה is not enough, because the case must also cover a צרה דצרה.

steps.title: גד and אשר also did יבום
steps.stepSummary: Answer: add more brothers, גד and אשר, who also did יבום. This creates a צרה of a צרה.
steps.simpleTranslation: For example, where גד and אשר also went on to do יבום with them.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers by adding two more brothers, גד and אשר, who also did יבום. This adds the extra layer of wives needed for a צרה דצרה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Each יבום adds a husband who already has his own wife, and that brings in another co-wife. With גד and אשר also doing יבום, there is now a co-wife of a co-wife. So the case can cover every part of the list.

keyTerms.meaning: For example / such as a case where
Where he then went on to (did it next)
And did יבום with them

steps.whatToRemember: Each detail in רב ספרא's long case has a job. The basic case gives 'her sister who is her יבמה.' יהודה's יבום adds a צרה. גד and אשר doing יבום add a צרה דצרה.

phrases.english: For example, where they then did יבום with them
also גד and אשר.

steps.triggerLanguage: כְּגוֹן דַּהֲדַר וְיַבְּמִינְהוּ נָמֵי גָּד וְאָשֵׁר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge in Step 25.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The case cannot cover a צרה דצרה.
steps.terutzMaskana: Add that גד and אשר also did יבום, and the case covers a צרה דצרה too.

steps.title: New משנה: two related widows fall to one brother
steps.stepSummary: Three brothers. Two were married to close relatives, like two sisters or a mother and daughter. Both husbands died. The widows do חליצה and not יבום. רבי שמעון exempts them completely.
steps.simpleTranslation: Three brothers. Two of them were married to two sisters, or a woman and her daughter, or a woman and her daughter's daughter, or a woman and her son's daughter. Both of those brothers died, so both widows come to the third brother. These women do חליצה and do not do יבום. רבי שמעון exempts them.
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה begins. It describes two widows who are close relatives of each other and who both fall to the same surviving brother.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Each widow is tied to the surviving brother through the יבום bond. Because of that bond, each one is treated like the relative of a woman connected to him, so he cannot do יבום with either. The חכמים still require חליצה, while רבי שמעון says even חליצה is not needed.

keyTerms.meaning: they do חליצה, the ceremony that releases a widow from יבום
they enter יבום, marrying the dead husband's brother
exempts; here, frees them even from חליצה
married to

steps.confusionAlert: The third brother was never married to either woman. The problem is not that he has a wife's sister in his house. The problem is that both widows are tied to him at the same moment through יבום, which links them to him together.

phrases.english: MISHNA: Three brothers,
two of whom were married to two sisters,
or a woman and her daughter,
or a woman and her daughter's daughter,
or a woman and her son's daughter —
these women perform חליצה and do not enter יבום.
And רבי שמעון exempts them.

steps.triggerLanguage: שְׁלֹשָׁה אַחִין, שְׁנַיִם מֵהֶן נְשׂוּאִין שְׁתֵּי אֲחָיוֹת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens a new משנה after the previous discussion of רב ספרא's case.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Two related widows who fall to one brother do חליצה and not יבום. רבי שמעון exempts them entirely.

steps.title: משנה: when one widow is already forbidden to him
steps.stepSummary: If one widow is an ערוה to the surviving brother, she is out of the picture, so he may do יבום with her sister. If she is forbidden only by an איסור מצוה or איסור קדושה, both still do חליצה.
steps.simpleTranslation: If one of them was forbidden to him as an ערוה, he may not marry her, but he may marry her sister. If it was only an איסור מצוה or an איסור קדושה, they do חליצה and not יבום.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה continues. It explains what happens when one of the two widows already has her own prohibition with the surviving brother.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An ערוה never falls to יבום at all. So in that case only one widow is really tied to him, and he may do יבום with her. A weaker prohibition, like מצוה or קדושה, does not cancel the bond, so both widows are still tied to him and both need חליצה.

keyTerms.meaning: a prohibition of forbidden relations, the strongest kind
a lighter prohibition (a rabbinic one, explained in an earlier משנה)
a prohibition tied to holiness, such as the special marriage rules for a כהן

steps.whyThisMatters: This sets up the גמרא's question in the next steps: an earlier משנה seems to have already taught the ערוה case.

phrases.english: If one of them was forbidden to him
with a prohibition of ערוה —
he is forbidden to her, and permitted to her sister.
If it was an איסור מצוה or an איסור קדושה —
they perform חליצה and do not enter יבום.

steps.triggerLanguage: הָיְתָה אַחַת מֵהֶן אֲסוּרָה עָלָיו אִיסּוּר עֶרְוָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Adds an exception to the משנה's main ruling.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: An ערוה drops out, so her sister may do יבום. With a מצוה or קדושה prohibition, both widows do חליצה.

steps.title: רבי שמעון's source: the verse about rival sisters
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא explains that רבי שמעון exempts both widows from חליצה and from יבום. He learns this from the פסוק about not taking a woman with her sister as a rival.
steps.simpleTranslation: It was taught: רבי שמעון exempts both women from חליצה and from יבום. The פסוק says, 'Do not take a woman to her sister to be a rival.' This means that at the moment they become rivals to each other, you cannot take even one of them.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא opens by quoting a ברייתא that explains רבי שמעון's view in the משנה and gives his source.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה only said 'רבי שמעון exempts.' The ברייתא makes clear that he means both women and both options, חליצה as well as יבום. He reads the פסוק as saying that once two sisters become rivals before one brother, neither can be 'taken' at all. That makes them like an ערוה, which needs no חליצה.

keyTerms.meaning: rival wives, women who are tied to the same man
to be a rival, a word from the פסוק
taking in marriage

phrases.english: GEMARA: It was taught in a ברייתא:
רבי שמעון exempts both of them
from חליצה and from יבום,

phrases.aramaic: שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְאִשָּׁה אֶל אֲחוֹתָהּ לֹא תִקָּח לִצְרוֹר״.
phrases.english: as it says: 'And you shall not take a woman to her sister, to be a rival.'
phrases.notes: ויקרא 18:18

phrases.english: At the time when they become rivals to each other —
phrases.notes: He means the moment both sisters fall to the same brother for יבום.

phrases.aramaic: לֹא יְהֵא לְךָ לִיקּוּחִין אֲפִילּוּ בְּאַחַת מֵהֶן.
phrases.english: you shall not be able to take even one of them.

steps.triggerLanguage: תַּנְיָא: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן פּוֹטֵר בִּשְׁתֵּיהֶן מִן הַחֲלִיצָה וּמִן הַיִּיבּוּם
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Explains and gives the source for רבי שמעון's view in the משנה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to רבי שמעון, two sisters who fall to one brother are exempt from both חליצה and יבום, based on ויקרא 18:18.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The פסוק 'ואשה אל אחותה לא תקח לצרור'

steps.title: Why repeat the forbidden-relative case?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why the משנה needed to teach the case where one widow is an ערוה. An earlier משנה already taught the same thing.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה said, 'If one of them was forbidden.' Why do I need this too? It is the same as what was already taught!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes the second part of the משנה and challenges it as repetitive.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An earlier משנה already taught that when one widow is an ערוה to the brother, she drops out and her sister may do יבום. So this line seems to add nothing new. The גמרא wants to know what new point it teaches.

keyTerms.meaning: why do I need this as well?
this is the same as that

phrases.english: 'If one of them was forbidden,' and so on.
phrases.notes: כו׳ means 'etc.' The גמרא is quoting the start of the משנה's line from step 28.

phrases.english: Why do I need this as well?
This is the same as that!
phrases.notes: 'That' is an earlier משנה that already taught this ערוה ruling.

steps.triggerLanguage: הָא תּוּ לְמָה לִי, הַיְינוּ הָךְ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Returns to the second half of the משנה and challenges why it is needed.
steps.kashyaTarget: The משנה's line about one widow being an ערוה
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Repetition: an earlier משנה already taught this exact ruling, so the line seems unnecessary.

steps.title: The repeat is needed for רבי שמעון
steps.stepSummary: The משנה repeats the ערוה case to teach that even רבי שמעון does not forbid the permitted sister through a rabbinic גזירה.
steps.simpleTranslation: It was needed for רבי שמעון. You might have thought: since רבי שמעון said that two sisters do neither חליצה nor יבום, we should make a גזירה here too, because this looks like the usual case of two sisters. The משנה teaches us that there is no such גזירה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the question from step 30. The repeat in the משנה is not extra, because it teaches something new about רבי שמעון's view.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי שמעון holds that two sisters who both need יבום from the same brother are both exempt. Here only one sister is really in the picture, since the other is an ערוה. Still, we might have feared that people would mix this up with the regular two-sisters case. The משנה tells us that רבי שמעון does not make that גזירה, so the יבם may do יבום with the permitted sister.

keyTerms.meaning: It was needed (to be taught)
You might have thought (introduces a wrong first idea)
To make a rabbinic decree (גזירה)
In general; the ordinary case
It teaches us (the point of the teaching)

steps.whatToRemember: Even רבי שמעון, who exempts two sisters completely, agrees that when one sister is an ערוה, the other may do יבום. There is no גזירה.
steps.confusionAlert: Do not mix up the two cases. In רבי שמעון's main case, both sisters can fall to the יבם, so both are exempt. Here one sister is an ערוה and is out of the picture, so the other is simply permitted.
steps.whyThisMatters: It shows that the earlier משנה only proved the rule for the חכמים. The repeat here extends the same rule to רבי שמעון.

phrases.english: It was needed according to רבי שמעון.
You might have thought to say:
Since רבי שמעון said

phrases.aramaic: שְׁתֵּי אֲחָיוֹת לֹא חוֹלְצוֹת וְלֹא מִתְיַיבְּמוֹת,
phrases.english: that two sisters neither do חליצה nor do יבום,
phrases.notes: This is רבי שמעון's view from step 29, where both sisters fall to the same brother.

phrases.english: we should make a decree because of two sisters in general,
so it teaches us that there is no decree.

steps.triggerLanguage: לְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אִיצְטְרִיךְ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the קשיא of step 30 about why the משנה repeats itself.
steps.terutzResolutionType: The repeat teaches a new point for a different opinion (רבי שמעון).
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Since רבי שמעון exempts two sisters, he might make a גזירה even when one sister is an ערוה.
steps.terutzMaskana: Even רבי שמעון makes no גזירה. The permitted sister may do יבום.

steps.title: Quoting the משנה about איסור מצוה
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the next phrase of the משנה, איסור מצוה, to begin discussing it.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה said: a prohibition of a מצוה, and so on.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is setting up its next discussion. It quotes the opening words of the משנה's line about widows forbidden by an איסור מצוה or איסור קדושה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In step 28, the משנה said that if a widow is forbidden only by an איסור מצוה or איסור קדושה, both widows do חליצה and not יבום. Unlike an ערוה, such a widow is not fully out of the picture. The גמרא quotes this phrase here to open its discussion of it, which continues on the next amud.

keyTerms.meaning: Short for וְכוּלֵּי: 'and so on'; the rest of the quote is left out

phrases.english: A prohibition of a מצוה, and so on.
phrases.notes: The גמרא quotes just the start of the משנה's line; the rest adds 'or of קדושה, they do חליצה and not יבום.'

steps.triggerLanguage: אִיסּוּר מִצְוָה כּוּ׳
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves on from the ערוה case to the next phrase of the משנה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: If a widow is forbidden by an איסור מצוה or איסור קדושה, both widows do חליצה and not יבום.
